mapper.select: SELECT i.code, i.name, i.institution_type, i.business_type, i.login_type, i.product_label, i.logo_url, i.display_order, i.is_active, CASE WHEN ci.institution_code IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_connected FROM institution i LEFT JOIN connected_institution ci ON ci.institution_code = i.code AND ci.connected_account_id = ( SELECT id FROM connected_account WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ) WHERE i.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY i.display_order
SELECT code, name, institution_type, business_type, login_type, product_label, logo_url, display_order, is_active FROM institution WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY display_order
SELECT code, name, institution_type, business_type, login_type, product_label, logo_url, display_order, is_active FROM institution WHERE code = #{code}
